title: Pablo Alborán Cancels 2nd Show Due to Pneumonia: ‘I’m Recovering Little by Little’
summary: The Spanish star provided an update on his health on Wednesday (Aug. 26).
body: UPDATE (Aug. 26): Pablo Alborán will not be able to perform this weekend at the Festival de la Luz in Boimorto, Spain. The Spanish star, who is recovering from a “severe pneumonia” that forced him to cancel a performance last week in Ciudad Real, remains on bed rest under doctor’s orders. “Family, I am recovering little by little from pneumonia, but the doctors insist that I continue resting for a few more days. For this reason, and much to my regret, I will not be able to take part in the Festival de la Luz this Sunday, August 30, in Boimorto,” Alborán said in a statement on his Instagram account on Wednesday (Aug. 26). “The recovery is taking a little longer than I’d like, but it’s on the right track; now it’s a matter of being patient and respecting the necessary timeframes so I can return to 100% and tackle the upcoming projects and concerts with full energy,” he added. “I am truly sorry for any inconvenience this may cause, and I sincerely appreciate your understanding, patience, and all the affection you’ve been sending my way these past few days.” Alborán, who is currently on his Global Tour KM0, announced U.S. dates for 2027 this week, kicking off on Febr…
